mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dream_content WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT emotion as label, COUNT(*) as value FROM dream_content WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND emotion IS NOT NULL AND emotion != '' GROUP BY emotion ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT place as label, COUNT(*) as value FROM dream_content WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND place IS NOT NULL AND place != '' GROUP BY place ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM dream_content WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT DISTINCT DATE(created_at) as dream_date FROM dream_content WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dream_date DESC
SELECT CHAR_LENGTH(content) FROM dream_content WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND content IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(content) DESC LIMIT 1
